queries.title: Paper searches
queries.description: Topics or keywords to search papers for, one per line ("large language models", "mRNA vaccine stability"). Each returns matching papers with abstracts and citation counts.

maxPerQuery.title: Papers per search
maxPerQuery.description: How many papers to return for each search.

sortBy.title: Sort papers by
sortBy.description: Order of paper results: best match, most cited first, or newest first.

yearFrom.title: Published from year
yearFrom.description: Only papers published in or after this year. 0 = no limit.

yearTo.title: Published up to year
yearTo.description: Only papers published in or before this year. 0 = no limit.

minCitations.title: Minimum citations
minCitations.description: Only papers cited at least this many times. 0 = no limit.

openAccessOnly.title: Open access only
openAccessOnly.description: Only papers with a free-to-read version (most rows then include a direct PDF link).

expertQueries.title: Find top experts on
expertQueries.description: Topics to find the leading researchers for, one per line ("crispr gene editing"). Returns the most-published authors on that topic with ORCID, h-index and current institutions - an expert lead list.

maxExpertsPerQuery.title: Experts per topic
maxExpertsPerQuery.description: How many top authors to return per expert topic.

authorNames.title: Author lookups
authorNames.description: Researcher names to look up, one per line ("Jennifer Doudna"). Returns their profile: ORCID, h-index, paper and citation counts, institutions.

maxAuthorsPerName.title: Matches per author name
maxAuthorsPerName.description: Names can be ambiguous; return up to this many best matches per name.

dois.title: DOI lookups
dois.description: DOIs to enrich, one per line ("10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2" or full doi.org URLs). Each returns the full paper record.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
